---
title: "Municipality Directory"
page-layout: full
---

Search for a municipality below. A municipality may link to more than one township report when it crosses township boundaries.

```{r}
#| label: municipality-directory
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(DT)

slugify <- function(x) {
  x |>
    str_to_lower() |>
    str_replace_all("[^a-z0-9]+", "-") |>
    str_remove("^-") |>
    str_remove("-$")
}

comm_ind <- read_csv("../Merriman RA/ptax/Output/comm_ind_PINs_2011to2022_timeseries.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(year == 2022) |>
  mutate(
    pin10 = str_sub(pin, 1, 10),
    township_slug = slugify(Township),
    report = paste0(
      '<a href="townships/', township_slug,
      '-projects.html">Open ', Township, ' report</a>'
    )
  )

municipality_directory <- comm_ind |>
  filter(!is.na(clean_name), clean_name != "", !is.na(Township), Township != "") |>
  group_by(Municipality = clean_name, Township, report) |>
  summarise(PINs = n_distinct(pin), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(Municipality, Township)

DT::datatable(
  municipality_directory,
  rownames = FALSE,
  escape = FALSE,
  filter = "top",
  options = list(
    pageLength = 25,
    searchHighlight = TRUE,
    autoWidth = TRUE
  ),
  colnames = c("Municipality", "Township", "PINs", "Township report")
)
```
